claims.citation: New York Herald, 12 August 1866, p. 3, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Brig Ellen Dickie (Br), McElhinney, Marseilles, May 19,
via Gibraltar June 11, with mdse, to H J DeWolf & Co.
June 29, John Sliney, a seaman from US steamer Colorado,
died of consumption. Aug 1, lat 37 40, lon 67, spoke ship
Uncle Toby, from Philadelphia for San Francisco, 8 days out,
who supplied us with provisions.
